question: To what kind of person must a particular thing be given according to the conditions stated?
premises: Something is marked as to be given.
It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is also to be given to one of resolved mind.
inference: The gift is prescribed for one who is endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
uncertainties: Whether both conditions apply to the same person or alternately remains open
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states, to one of resolved mind.
